scripts.test: pnpm --filter @remotearc/execution-core test:integration && pnpm --filter @remotearc/mcp test:smoke && pnpm test:browser
scripts.test:recovery: pnpm --filter @remotearc/execution-core exec tsx ../cli/scripts/background-recovery-test.ts && pnpm build:cli && pnpm --filter @remotearc/execution-core exec tsx ../cli/scripts/attached-terminal-test.ts
scripts.test:goals: node apps/relay/scripts/goal-continuation-test.mjs && node apps/relay/scripts/planned-goal-test.mjs && pnpm --filter @remotearc/execution-core exec tsx ../cli/scripts/goal-workspace-test.ts
scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @remotearc/ui test:security && pnpm test && pnpm test:goals && pnpm test:runtime-surface && pnpm test:seo && pnpm --filter @remotearc/relay test:security
scripts.publish:cli: pnpm build:cli && CLI_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./packages/cli/package.json').version") && grep -q "$CLI_VERSION" packages/cli/dist/index.js && grep -q 'https://mcp.remotearc.app' packages/cli/dist/index.js && grep -q '/api/device/heartbeat' packages/cli/dist/index.js && cd packages/cli && npm publish
